s02-E.old: Take charge of the repair team and the money, and face the blame if it goes wrong
s02-E.new: Lead the repair team, and face the blame if it goes wrong
s02-E.why: Removes 'and the money' (budgeting reads C); one leadership activity.

s03-C.old: Plan the repair step by step and list the parts needed, rewriting it as things change
s03-C.new: Write up a step-by-step repair checklist, redoing it as things change
s03-C.why: Merges planning and parts-listing into one record-keeping task.

s04-E.old: Persuade passers-by to buy and strike a good deal
s04-E.new: Sell the fresh juice to passers-by on the village road
s04-E.why: Single selling activity; drops the separate bargaining skill and the 'persuade' trigger.

s05-S.old: Gather the lost travellers and keep their spirits up on a long, cold walk
s05-S.new: Lift the lost travellers' spirits on a long, cold walk
s05-S.why: Drops 'gather' (rounding up reads as leading); keeps the supportive activity.

s06-E.old: Set prices and win over buyers, knowing some will walk away
s06-E.new: Win over the passing buyers, knowing some will walk away
s06-E.why: Drops 'set prices' (pricing reads C); one persuading activity without the trigger word.

s06-C.old: Sort the stock and label shelves so buyers find things fast, before the doors open
s06-C.new: Label the shelves so buyers find things fast, before the doors open
s06-C.why: One organising activity instead of sort + label.

s07-A.old: Draw up a boat for the crossing that may not float the first time
s07-A.new: Dream up a new boat shape for the crossing, though it may not float the first time
s07-A.why: Original 'draw up a boat' reads as engineering; 'dream up a new shape' foregrounds invention while keeping the same cost.

s09-E.old: Split the climbers into teams and set the pace, though some will grumble at your choices
s09-E.new: Lead the climbers to the top, though some will grumble at your choices
s09-E.why: One leadership act instead of team-splitting (organising) + pace-setting.

s11-E.old: Run the club night and sign up new members
s11-E.new: Recruit new members for the stargazing club
s11-E.why: One enterprising act; drops event-hosting which overlaps with the S card.

s12-C.old: Label every herb and keep the beds in tidy rows
s12-C.new: Label each herb bed so nothing gets mixed up
s12-C.why: Drops 'keep the beds in tidy rows' (gardening reads R); avoids 'every'.

s13-E.old: Start a new newspaper and find people to pay for it, at the risk it does not sell
s13-E.new: Launch a new newspaper for the quarter, at the risk it does not sell
s13-E.why: One founding activity; drops the separate fundraising/selling clause.

s14-E.old: Lead the clinic team and choose who is seen first, even when someone has to wait
s14-E.new: Lead the clinic team tonight, even when someone has to wait
s14-E.why: One leadership activity; triage choice was a second decision-making task.

s15-E.old: Run the stalls and set the prices, then face the stallholders if sales are slow
s15-E.new: Manage the festival stalls, then face the stallholders if sales are slow
s15-E.why: Drops 'set the prices' (pricing reads C); one managing activity.
